description: Signal bias with setup levels and invalidation. Rules-based bias (bullish/lean_bullish/neutral/lean_bearish/bearish) with score, confidence, setup, weighted factors, invalidation. tf sets candle size and lookback (5m=1H to 1w=1Y): shorter is faster but noisier, longer is slower but higher-conviction. Accuracy free at /api/v1/track-record. Quick direction + one setup; get_trade_plan ($0.03) adds target-before-stop odds, get_market_regime ($0.005) is trend/volatility only. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_signal_bias
